# Patricia Canzoneri-Fitzpatrick (R): NYS Senate, District 9

<!-- Generated by build.py from meta.json and claims.csv. Do not edit by hand. -->

Independent, source-by-source review of the claims on **Patricia Canzoneri-Fitzpatrick's** campaign website ([campaign home page and Meet Patricia](https://www.patriciaforsenate.com/)), captured **2026-11-26**. Incumbent. Opponent: [Lisa Vider](../vider-lisa/) (D).

**Live site:** <https://rike4545.github.io/LI-CandidateCheck/#/c/canzoneri-fitzpatrick-patricia> · method: [METHODOLOGY.md](../../METHODOLOGY.md)

> Scope: this review tests whether each claim is **verifiable** and **accurate as stated**. It does not rate the candidate, the opponent, or policy positions.

## Bottom line

This is her 2022 first-run site, never updated. It still says she will fight "bail laws written by our current Senator", though she has been the senator since 2023, and it has a footer link to her 2020 Assembly campaign. The biography itself checks out.

1. Malverne trustee, police commissioner and deputy mayor roles are confirmed.
2. The page's copyright reads 2022 and it never mentions that she is the incumbent.
